analysis:
The supplied units are base_text excerpts (lines 2352-2791) of CHANGELOG.md, which is documentation only. The patch for the head shows the changelog gaining a new v0.10.7 candidate section, with only a truncated excerpt visible. I found no code, configuration, wire-protocol or deployment change in the supplied evidence. Two base excerpts hold historical entries and carry no new behavior on the head side. The base text references security-relevant topics, all pre-existing and already covered by the threat model:
- encrypted SSD prefix cache (T-041)
- account scoping and cacheSalt
- App Attest authorization (TB-011, T-053)
- erasure
- soft-delete mutation gates

These are descriptions of past changes. I did not verify them against code, and I make no claims about their correctness. The visible head patch excerpt adds upgrade and rollout notes: both Macs of a pair must run the same version, pairing fails closed on a mismatch, and Gemma 4 and MiMo tensor-parallel models are declared public in ClusterPublicModels. The excerpt is truncated, and the cluster, pair-update and tensor-parallel wire changes it mentions (#1702, #1706, #1707, #1715, #1716, #1723, #1727, #1736) are not visible as source. Any security conclusion about pair or cluster trust boundaries, the coordinated update mechanism, or pair-serving grants and parity qualifications would need the actual code diffs. This change is not itself a regression, and the threat model does not appear to need updating from this changelog alone. Reviewers of the code PRs should check whether cluster pairing and coordinated update introduce a new trust boundary that is not in the threat model; no TB entry for a Mac-to-Mac pair is in the supplied index.
